FN-LR2GAYW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 220
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Rep. Corley Ellis
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/26/2024
House Bill 220 as introduced would require: 1) accommodation intermediaries to collect
transient occupancy tax from accommodation providers; and 2) both parties to submit annual
reports to the Department of Revenue. This bill could also increase the administrative
obligations of the department to adopt rules to implement and administer this bill.
